title: The 480-turn playtest limit was reached one room before the actual Hollow Throne, despite following a fairly efficient main-quest path (3 hollows rested, all key items gathered) — for a game whose own text estimates '40-70 turns per hold, fifteen holds' and treats reaching Marrowgate as roughly the midpoint, the true ending is effectively unreachable within a normal single-session turn budget once any meaningful side content is engaged.
